Frontend: AtelierMediaDirection UI mounts under 'Libreria media' tab, all data-testids present (amd-root, amd-dropzone, 4 preset chips, 5 sliders, amd-file-input, amd-tiles), file upload via hidden input → preview renders → publish succeeds → tile added to gallery (count went to 9/20). IT-IT locale renders 'Componi l'atmosfera.' / 'Trascina un'immagine · o sfoglia' with no raw i18n token leaks; EN-US keys present in /app/frontend/src/i18n/strings/en-US.json (eyebrow=Atelier · Media Direction, title=Compose the atmosphere.). I18n footer badge confirms MISS 0 · LEAK 0.
critical_code_review_comments: atelier_media.py L156: `await file.read()` reads full file before mime/size validation — for very large uploads this loads multi-MB into memory before rejection. Consider rejecting on Content-Length header first.

atelier_media.py L171-180: Asset cap query (`is_active=true`) runs BEFORE Pillow processing — good. However, with concurrent uploads from the same tenant a race condition could exceed the cap by 1–2 assets. Acceptable for MVP soft-cap but worth a DB-level constraint or transaction for hard enforcement.

atelier_media.py L335-343: Soft-archive storage cleanup uses string parsing on `.jpg` extension only. If extension ever becomes `.webp` the variant deletion silently skips. Use the stored `storage_path` + sibling derivation more robustly.

atelier_media_processor.py L60: Unreachable elif `img.mode == 'RGBA'` branch — RGBA was converted to RGB on the prior line. Dead code; the alpha-flatten block never executes. Move the RGBA flatten BEFORE the `convert('RGB')` step or restructure mode handling.

Backend module-level GRADING_PRESETS duplicates the same values stored in the DB (per migration 070). If presets ever drift between code and DB they will silently diverge; consider sourcing presets from the DB or a single shared constants module.

Frontend hidden input/dropzone: amd-publish and amd-preview testids are only mounted after a file is selected. Tests should respect that two-phase rendering — current testids strategy is correct, just call it out for future agents.
Frontend AtelierMediaDirection.jsx (~570 LOC + sibling css 600+) is on the boundary of the 700-line guideline — split focal-point canvas + slider grid into sub-components for maintainability.
